jobs.description:
One of the world's most international universities, a unique founding mission positions Central European University as both an acclaimed center for the study of economic, historical, social and political challenges, and a source of support for building open and democratic societies that respect human rights and human dignity. jobs.description:
1 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems  * As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV.
 * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures.
 * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components.
 * You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools.
 * You define power-stage architectures, including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures.

 * You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration.
 * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines.
 * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware.
 * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues.
 * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders.
 * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
 *  Experience in power electronic systems
 * Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies.
 * Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management.
 * Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred)

 * Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis
 * Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems
 * business-fluent English ; German skills are a nice to have.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (m/f/d) ¿ Lifestyle Check & Wellabe Lab Systems
jobs.description:
1 Software Engineer (m/f/d) ¿ Lifestyle Check & Wellabe Lab Systems Your mission
Ownership Lifestyle Check - lab systems 

 * Taking over and owning the on-site Windows service that bridges our medical measurement devices to the platform. It drives around 10 device families via Bluetooth, serial, TCP and file exchange. 
 * Operation, maintenance and further development of the device drivers, the local REST API, the system-tray status UI, firmware updates and the Windows installer. 
 * Building and shipping releases: PyInstaller executable, NSIS installer, Windows Defender/firewall handling, auto-update mechanism and the PT10 ESP32 firmware flasher. 
 * Rolling out releases to the lab sites and troubleshooting problems that occur on-site - including occasional travel to our locations. 
 * Securing and documenting the systems so they can be maintained by more than one person in the long run. 

Lab operator frontend and backend

 * Owning the lab operator web app, an Angular / Ionic / Electron application that runs on the lab PC and guides the operator through login, packages, stations, appointments and the checkup flow. 
 * Maintaining and improving the Capacitor/Electron build and the GitHub Actions release pipeline. 
 * Owning the device configuration backend, a Django REST backend that stores lab and device configuration, authenticates lab operators, generates signed Google Cloud Storage URLs and receives logs from the field. 
 * Keeping the REST APIs, PostgreSQL models, authentication bridge and upload pipeline secure and reliable.

Product-wide improvements and integrations

 * Driving refactoring, dependency updates and reliability improvements across the Lifestyle Check stack. 
 * Integrating with the wider Wellabe platform: the Laravel/PHP admin platform for device master data, the Flask backend that handles body-age calculations and reporting, and the Ionic/Capacitor mobile app for user-facing results. 
 * Improving observability: centralised logging, clearer error signals and faster remote diagnosis so that "it didn't work in Munich on Tuesday" becomes solvable from your desk. 
 * Maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and release workflows.

Data quality & collaboration

 * Quality and robustness ownership - you design and maintain solutions that are reliable, fit our business needs and are reasonably easy to operate and maintain. 
 * Careful handling of health data - data protection and security are not a formality here. 
 * Collaboration with our development team.

Your profile
Must-haves

 * Strong Python skills - you can find your way into unfamiliar, grown code and own both Flask and Django backends. 
 * Experience with hardware integration - serial interfaces, Bluetooth, TCP; you can read a device protocol and understand what is happening on the wire. 
 * Frontend skills - solid Angular/TypeScript experience and a practical understanding of Ionic/Capacitor or Electron build chains. 
 * Strong SQL and experience with relational databases (we use PostgreSQL and SQLite). 
 * Remote debugging from incomplete information - you can reconstruct what happened from logs, screenshots and second-hand descriptions, without being able to reproduce the issue locally. 
 * Willingness to travel to our offices in Munich and Vienna, and enjoyment of working with real devices. 
 * Fluent German - you need to communicate with local teams and support staff at our lab sites in German-speaking countries. 
 * Good English - collaboration in an international team.

Nice-to-haves

 * Windows engineering - services, packaging, installers, firewall; our application runs unattended on the on-site PCs. 
 * PyInstaller + NSIS experience, or comparable desktop-deployment tooling. 
 * PHP / Laravel basics so you can read and coordinate changes in our admin platform. 
 * Security awareness - patching, handling secrets, dependency management, GDPR in a health context.

jobs.occupation: Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders), Österreichische Rundfunksender GmbH (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: From DEV bench to center stage -- build the future of streaming.   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To lead our Innovation & Research LAB -- publicly known as BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (labs.bigbluemarble.com) -- at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Program Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Are you a developer at heart who's ready for the next chapter -- one where you spend less time in the IDE and more time shaping which technologies your company bets on next? Do you want to turn prototypes into real business impact, represent your company on international stages, and build the innovation ecosystem of a streaming platform from the ground up? If you have a technical background and the ambition to grow into a coordinating, outward-facing leadership role, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs is where you belong. Your responsibilities:   Innovation  Scouting Innovation is not an end in itself for us. We want to understand early which technologies will shape the streaming world of tomorrow -- and which of them are actually relevant for our platform and our customers. You scout new technologies, solutions, start-ups, and trends in the streaming and media-tech space. You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. You attend industry conferences, trade fairs, and events at home and abroad, build a relevant network, and bring fresh impulses into the company. You work closely with our Innovation Management and Professional Services team to move promising technologies from first assessment through to potential Proofs of Concept. You translate your findings into clear, digestible formats and share your knowledge internally and externally -- through technical blog posts, presentations, or trend and technology analyses. AI and automation are a permanent part of your technology radar -- always with an eye on concrete use cases in the streaming and platform environment. Innovation Lab & Proof of Concept Program You lead the operational activities of BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs and coordinate its day-to-day innovation processes. You organize and facilitate our bi-weekly Proof of Concept (PoC) sprints together with our Full Stack Development team. Together with Product Management, you evaluate ideas entering the innovation funnel, prioritize opportunities, and initiate new PoCs. You coordinate PoCs from idea validation to successful completion, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams. You make sure PoC outcomes are properly documented and turned into reusable knowledge, technical assets, or follow-up initiatives. You continuously improve our Lab processes, fostering an agile, execution-oriented innovation culture. Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem -- universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners. You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives. You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility. You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities. Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally. You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats. You prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends. You promote knowledge sharing across teams and help translate innovation into long-term business value. Your background: A technical foundation, not necessarily a management CV. You have worked as a (Full Stack) Software Developer, Engineer, or in a comparable hands-on technical role -- and you understand modern software development, cloud technologies, and digital platforms from the inside. A Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a comparable technical discipline -- helpful for writing well-founded technical papers and conference contributions. Equivalent professional experience is welcome in place of a formal degree. A genuine wish to change direction: you're ready to trade day-to-day coding for coordinating people, representing the company externally, and shaping innovation strategy. Prior exposure to project or product coordination is a plus, not a requirement. Streaming and broadcast media know-how is very welcome -- but if you bring strong technical fundamentals, we're confident you can build this knowledge quickly on the job. You're comfortable presenting, networking, and representing BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in front of external audiences -- at conferences, workshops, and partner meetings. You enjoy structuring ambiguous, early-stage ideas, coordinating people across disciplines, and turning promising concepts into tangible outcomes. Experience contributing to technical blogs, conference papers, white papers, or presentations is a strong asset. Comfortable working in agile environments and facilitating sprint-based collaboration. Experience with universities, research institutions, start-ups, or technology partners is a plus. Fluent English (C1/C2) and German (minimum B2) are required. What we're proposing for you: In addition to an annual salary in line with the market, we offer you a package of benefits consisting of a mobility allowance for the Wiener Linien annual ticket or the KLIMATICKET, a company canteen, our bonus programme, the pension fund and a sports programme. Place of work: Vienna (remote option), working hours: 38,5hours per week, reference number: OC1026CINSE, starting date: 10/2026. We are happy to offer professionals with relevant training and experience a gross annual salary in line with the market of between 56,000 and 72,000 euros (salary group 4, Telekom-KV, 38,5 h/week)*. Remote work Good communication and direct cooperation are very important to us. You can work from home, from the modern office or hybrid.
